title: Dutch Population Relocation Networks
subtitle: Netherlands · 2011–2024
description: Explore reconstructed municipality-level relocation flows by year range and demographic stratum. Municipality colours show net relocation balance, while directed curves show the strongest origin–destination flows.
imageAlt: The Dutch Population Relocation Networks atlas, showing demographic controls and a map of municipal net relocation flows in the Netherlands.

title: Job-Home Networks in Spain
subtitle: Spain · 2022–2024
description: Explore Spain’s job–home networks across six workplace-attendance recurrence layers. Directed flows show residential-to-employment connections, while district colours reveal hybrid-work intensity, network outcomes, settlement context, and spatial heterogeneity.
imageAlt: Interactive atlas of hybrid-work and job–home networks in Spain, showing district-level measures and directed residential-to-employment flows across workplace-attendance recurrence layers.

title: Power Network Map on Social Media
subtitle: Bell and Drum Tower Planning Controversy, Beijing · 2012–2014
description: An interactive visualisation of three anonymised Weibo forwarding networks formed during the Bell and Drum Tower planning controversy in Beijing. Users can switch between expert-, government-, and civil-society-initiated networks to explore community structure, interaction intensity, and node prominence.
imageAlt: Interactive visualisation of an anonymised expert-initiated Weibo forwarding network, with filtering controls on the left and a community-coloured network graph on the right.
